messages:
Priya (partnerships): Quick shoutout — Pinewave Diagnostics is live as an ISV listing on AWS Marketplace and we kicked off a HIPAA-private pilot on Redwood Private yesterday. This is a strategic healthcare anchor.
Derek (AE): Huge — closed a 2yr dedicated pilot + marketplace listing. Committed reserved capacity + marketplace listing fees in the deal.
Megan (Customer Success): CS kickoff scheduled tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. Runbook for PHI handling is ready; will share access/notes after the meeting. Need SSO + KMS ownership from infra.
Alex (engineering): I can own the KMS integration and audit-log enablement. @deploy-bot can you run the Private deploy security checklist and post results?
deploy-bot: Security checklist executed for Pinewave (private-pilot). KMS policy verified, audit-logs enabled, network ACLs confirmed. Artifact: https://redwood.internal/reports/pinewave-1719501111
Derek (AE): Heads up — Pinewave asked for a 99.9% latency SLA on gen endpoints. @Olivia (prod) can you estimate the config and cost tradeoffs?
Olivia (prod): Plan: allocate a small Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv), enable KV caching + per-route batching, and pin model v1. Est. median p50 latency ~110ms for 1k tokens under their baseline traffic. I'll add notes to the rollout doc and tag cost delta.
Megan (Customer Success): They're interested in a case study if pilot shows ROI. We should capture before/after latency, cost per inference, and a CTO quote during pilot week 2.
Priya (partnerships): Action items: 1) Marketing one-pager + logo approval, 2) Draft case study timeline (3 weeks), 3) Confirm marketplace billing flow. Who owns marketing collateral?
Jade (marketing): I'll own the marketing one-pager and the initial case study draft. Reached out to Pinewave for logo + legal approval.
Derek (AE): Pinewave engineering asked for a sandbox API key scoped to their test engineers. @Alex can we provision a scoped key against the sandbox cluster with RBAC?
Alex (engineering): Yep — provisioning a scoped sandbox key limited to non-prod data, token expiry 30d, and no write access to customer data. Will post the key URL to the secure onboarding doc.
Megan (Customer Success): Adding to onboarding checklist: sandbox key, SOC2 attestation copy, KMS rotation schedule, and contact for escalation.
Priya (partnerships): This is a great vertical reference — Pinewave has 200+ lab partners and could help drive more ISV listings in healthcare. :tada:
Olivia (prod): Monitoring: added alert for token throughput >75% of pool; will enable burst autoscale if needed and notify infra. Also configuring per-route throttles to protect latency SLOs.
Priya (partnerships): Thanks team — I'll update this thread once the marketplace listing goes public and when we have logo/legal sign-off. :raised_hands:
